parameters.content:
## START HERE: Jobber CSV-Fallback Triage (DRAFT v0.1.0)
The zero-OAuth way in, and the recommended way to start, for every Jobber plan. Export your Jobs, Invoices, and Quotes reports from Jobber as CSV, get them into n8n, and get the Morning Ops digest (unscheduled / late / action-required jobs, requires-invoicing and past-due, stalled high-value quotes) to the OWNER only.

**Test it in about 2 minutes:**
1. Import this file (done). It is imported inactive. The webhook, email, and schedule triggers are switched off.
2. testMode is on and **source** defaults to test, which is fictional sample data (fixtures/sample-jobber-export-*.csv). Click **Execute workflow** on Manual Test Run. You get a [TEST] digest.
3. Compare with sample_morning_digest.md in the pack.
4. Set source = csv, put your own exports in csvFolder, run again. Still [TEST].
5. Only then enable one trigger. See the go-live note.

Status: DRAFT. Workflow JSON and Code nodes checked locally with fictional data. NOT tested against a live Jobber, Gmail, or Slack account.

## Config fields
- **source**: test (built-in fictional sample, default) | csv (read your exports). An upload that arrives by webhook or email is always treated as csv. There is no jobber (API) source in this file.
- **testMode**: ON by default. Messages are labeled [TEST]. source = test always forces it on.
- **delivery**: email | slack | both | none. Owner only.
- **ownerEmail / ownerSlackChannel**: YOUR address and a private channel. Never a customer. Read from this Config node only, never from an uploaded row or email header.
- **csvFolder**: watch folder for manual and scheduled runs. n8n only reads files inside its allowed folder. The Read node reads every .csv in it.
- **asOfOverride**: ISO time to pretend it is a different moment, for an export from earlier. Blank = now.
- **pastDueMinDays** (1), **quoteStalledDays** (blank until configured), **quoteMinValue** (1000): starting points, not industry standards.
- The scheduled run uses Config source, so set source = csv before you enable the schedule.

## Safety defaults
- Imported **inactive**. The Schedule, Webhook, and Email-attachment triggers are all **disabled**.
- **testMode** ON; source = **test** (fictional sample).
- **Zero Jobber write-back**: this file never calls Jobber at all. It only reads the CSV you give it.
- **Owner-only output**: Gmail and Slack recipients come from ownerEmail / ownerSlackChannel. No SMS, no Twilio, no customer email, no review request, no reminder blast.
- The email trigger only READS an inbound message. It does not reply, label, or forward.
- The webhook expects a header-auth credential (placeholder). Never expose it without one.
- The stalled-quote list is for a human call or personal note.
- Never invents numbers. A missing report becomes a "Heads-up" line.

## CSV-Fallback (every Jobber plan, no OAuth, no App Review)
**Export:** in Jobber, run the Jobs (One-off jobs), Invoices, and Quotes reports and export each to CSV. Reports are on all Jobber plans (some columns need a higher plan). Jobber's Report Scheduler app can email reports on a schedule. Any one report is enough; a missing one becomes a Heads-up.
**Required columns:** Jobs: Job #, Status. Invoices: Invoice #, Invoice Status, Due date, Balance ($). Quotes: Quote #, Status, Total ($), and Sent date. A missing one produces a plain-language Heads-up that names it and lists the headers seen, not a crash.
**Headers are matched loosely** (case, punctuation, spaces/underscores/hyphens ignored). The aliases are built from the column names Jobber's help center lists; the exact header text of a real export has NOT been checked against a live account.
**Dates** like 3/10/2026 9:50 AM are shop-local in the Config timezone. Impossible dates (2026-02-30) and unclosed quotes are reported, never silently accepted.
**Three ways in:** (1) Webhook: POST the file(s) as multipart field "data". (2) Email attachment from an allowed sender set in the Gmail trigger query. (3) Watch folder: drop the files in csvFolder.

## Credentials (placeholders only)
PLACEHOLDER_GMAIL (inbound email trigger and owner email), PLACEHOLDER_SLACK, PLACEHOLDER_WEBHOOK_HEADER_AUTH (webhook). No Jobber credential is used or needed. No secrets are stored in this file. GraphQL paths and fields are unverified until a live Jobber test, and they are not used here at all.

## Hard stop before go-live
Do not turn testMode off or enable a trigger until: (1) a clean [TEST] run from the sample export, (2) a clean [TEST] run from YOUR exports, spot-checked by hand against Jobber, (3) ownerEmail / ownerSlackChannel confirmed as owner-only, (4) the Gmail query limited to one sender you trust and the webhook behind header auth, (5) an owner has signed off in writing. Even live, this workflow only reports to the owner.
